ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SPOT uses your location to show where you are on the map and to sort nearby gyms by distance. Your coordinates are not stored.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SPOT opens your photo library so you can choose a profile photo, a gym photo or a technique video.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: SPOT uses the camera to scan the check-in QR code at your gym's reception, to record technique videos and to take a profile photo.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SPOT uses the microphone only when you record a technique video with sound.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: The motion sensor is linked together with location services. SPOT does not collect or store motion data.
